functional.summary: Live check against this worktree's own servers (backend cwd verified as this checkout, frontend restarted clean after an HMR artifact). Generated the Agriculture / Nursery / DUB / 2026-07-01 statement and exercised every contract. Clicking 9 Admin Expenses' Actual opens 37 DESCENDANT leaves - first row 'Petrol and Diesel Charges' GL 55010901, a grandchild under 9.01 Vehicle Maintenance - proving the flatten does not stop at children, and the Total reads the clicked figure. The Grand Total opens 81 flattened roots including the unmapped-GL line and foots to Budget 1,00,50,136.29 and Actual 1,15,12,712.07, the exact demo-ready values the statement spec names. The panel is block-sensitive: the FY 26-27 YTD block shows Budget 44,26,500 against July's 1,32,000 for the same node. Of 106 statement rows exactly 25 carry an Actual control - the non-leaf nodes - and Budget, Roll-over and % expose no button, no tabbable element and no pointer cursor anywhere; leaf Actuals are plain text as the human settled, and the 'Click any Actual' copy is correctly absent until task 3. Escape closes the panel, a scrim click closes it, and focus returns to the opening button. The prototype's motion is live: computed animationName is 'slidein' on the panel and 'fadein' on the scrim.
manual_validation_steps: Confirmed the dev servers are THIS worktree before trusting anything: backend process cwd resolves to this checkout's backend directory, frontend restarted from this tree.
Generated the statement for Agriculture / Nursery / DUB / 2026-07-01 and confirmed 106 rows render.
Clicked 9 Admin Expenses' July Actual: 37 descendant leaves listed, first row a third-level GL leaf, Total 5,14,749 equal to the clicked cell, chip reads 'Statement outline order'.
Clicked the same node's FY 26-27 YTD Actual: Budget 44,26,500 rather than July's 1,32,000, proving the panel reads the clicked block and not measures[0].
Clicked the Grand Total: 81 flattened roots including unmapped-GL, footing to 1,00,50,136.29 / 1,15,12,712.07.
Probed Budget, Roll-over and % cells: no button, no tabbable descendant, cursor auto, no click handler. Probed a leaf row's Actual: no button, cursor auto.
Escape closed the panel and focus returned to a button; a scrim click closed it too.
Re-ran the whole flow after the ISO-label fix and confirmed the meta line reads 'July 2026 - 37 lines'.
non_blocking_findings: The statement's S.No column shows '31' for the Land Levelling line. This is the workbook's own malformed value, already ledgered as D-0034, not a panel defect.

The frontend dev server needed a restart mid-check after Fast Refresh corrupted its bundle following many consecutive edits ('__webpack' TypeError, HTTP 500). Nothing in the shipped code; noted so a future check does not misread it as a regression.
residual_risks: Design parity was judged against docs/design/3F-Financial-MIS with two departures recorded in the task plan and approved by the human: the sort chip reads 'Statement outline order' rather than the prototype's 'Actual descending' (which would misdescribe outline-ordered rows), and the 'Click any Actual to see its transactions' copy is held for task 3.
The exact-paise secondary line is new UI with no prototype counterpart; it follows the statement's rupee and Indian-grouping convention with the paise retained.

automated.summary: All five verify commands and all seven required test leaves pass, each confirmed by reading the junit testcase name and a non-zero executed count rather than the exit code (vitest exits 0 having asserted nothing when -t matches no leaf, D-0031). The leaves cover the descendant flatten and its paise-exact footing three levels deep, the clicked-block case against a divergent FY-YTD fixture, the Grand Total special case over response.tree roots, the derived zero-budget percentage labels, a spy proving zero API calls, the full dialog contract (initial focus, Escape, scrim click, Tab and Shift+Tab trap, focus return), and the inertness of Budget, Roll-over, % and leaf Actuals. Design work was done under emil-design-eng and frontend-design: both found real defects that were fixed by the implementer rather than waved through.
automated.pass_fail_summary: frontend: 35 tests passed, 0 failed; required leaves: 7/7 executed under their exact testcase name; typecheck, lint, format:check and the production build all clean
remaining_gaps: Leaf Actuals are inert and the prototype's 'Click any Actual to see its transactions' copy is absent by design, both settled by the human at the task grill; task 3 upgrades the cells and adds the copy together.
